verdict.reasons: The candidate image clearly displays a coherent agromony scene featuring neutral seedlings and continuous thin drip-tape laterals with localized wetting, aligning well with the article's intent. The single primary product, an upright white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll, is correctly identified and fully visible with authentic and readable branding (including the authorized Persian and English sleeve captions). The required watermark 'AFP | 09134922013' is legitimately present. The installed laterals in the background are technically plausible and evaluated appropriately as technical evidence, without being mistaken for an additional commercial roll or hardware substitute. There are no core defects such as mixed product families, invented logos, people, impossible geometry, or collage layouts. Minor framing or soil-shape variations are advisory and do not detract from the overall quality, which comfortably exceeds the 90-point threshold.

focused_physical_review.reason: Visual inspection of the full frame and details shows: 1) A broad, uninterrupted gap of soil is visible around the complete footprint of the white-and-blue package, including the front and sides where visible, confirming 'clear_soil_gap': true. 2) The irrigation lateral lines run in the background soil rows but do not touch, cross, or disappear behind the base of the package, confirming 'line_touches_or_crosses_package': false. 3) No additional loose coils or uninstalled product rolls are present on the soil, confirming 'extra_loose_product_coil': false. 4) The carton surfaces and base are clean; there are no protruding white ribbons, straps, or tape tails emerging from the packaging, confirming 'package_has_protruding_strip': false.
